title: Handbook governance, employment relationship, company policy and complaint procedure - 2025 handbook
summary: Currentest ingested complete RTEC handbook provisions governing handbook authority, at-will employment, policy amendment, equal-merit company policy, grievance/complaint escalation, orientation responsibility, and handbook acknowledgment/return.

claims.claim: The handbook states that it is not an employment contract, describes employment as at-will, and places suspension/termination authority with the Executive Director.

RTEC reserves the right to amend policies/procedures at its discretion, with amended policy stated to become effective immediately; the handbook is for internal use and must be returned with company property at separation.

RTEC's company policy describes recruitment, employment, training and promotion based on merit and nondiscrimination, with the Executive Director assigned monitoring responsibility and complaints reportable to the immediate supervisor or Executive Director.

evidence.note: Later signed 2026 EEO policy is the controlling current EEO source where it differs.

claims.claim: The complaint procedure directs employees first to the supervisor and, if unresolved, to the Executive Director; it states the Executive Director will review the matter and advise the employee of the decision within ten workdays after escalation.

evidence.note: The section also says 'reasonable time' generally means five working days and reserves discretion to reject improper complaints.

claims.claim: The Human Resource Manager and employee's supervisor are responsible for orienting the employee to workplace expectations, including the dress-code policy.

The certificate of receipt requires the employee to acknowledge responsibility for knowing and keeping the manual updated, recognizes company ownership/return requirements, and reiterates that the manual does not alter at-will status.

steps: Use the handbook as the policy reference for employees.
Raise ordinary work-related complaints first with the supervisor.
Escalate unresolved complaints to the Executive Director.
Orient employees to workplace expectations and obtain/retain handbook acknowledgment.
decisions: Whether a complaint is appropriate for the grievance procedure.
Whether corrective employment action is taken under at-will authority.
deadlines: Executive Director decision within ten workdays after an appropriate complaint is brought to their attention.
The complaint section defines 'reasonable time' generally as five working days.
exceptions: Later standalone policies supersede individual handbook sections where they are more recent and authoritative.
controls: No retaliation/discrimination for making a complaint is stated in the complaint section.
unresolved_questions: What current form or system records handbook acknowledgments and complaint escalations?
automation_candidates: Track handbook version acknowledgments and missing receipts.
Complaint routing checklist with escalation/deadline reminders.

provenance.notes: Validated as faithful extraction of the complete 2025 handbook; later section-specific sources can supersede it.
